svg.title: Corrected diagram of the offload crossover point against task size
svg.desc: A chart with task size on the x-axis and cost on the y-axis. Local cost rises steeply with task size. Two offload-cost lines are shown: one for decades ago, high and nearly flat, crossing the local line only at very large task sizes; one for today, lower and flatter, crossing the local line at a much smaller task size. Below, four arrows show compute speed, bandwidth, latency, and storage cost changing at different rates, explaining why the crossover moved.
